metadata.title: Amanda Fonseca | Full-stack Developer
metadata.description: Amanda Fonseca’s portfolio: full-stack web development, selected projects and professional experience.

portfolioHero.description: I work with front-end and back-end. I like code that holds up as it grows and screens that explain themselves.

expertise.label: Expertise
expertise.description: I work across front-end, back-end and product. I like to understand the problem before the first line of code.

uniquadra.category: My first project in college: a system to book sports courts at the University of Fortaleza (Unifor).
uniquadra.details: UniQuadra brings together Unifor's sports catalog, court bookings and a digital student card.
highlights: Worked on the Node.js back end.
Split the code into classes, each with a single responsibility.

farminghabit.category: A habit app that plays like a game: farm pixel art, a consistency heatmap and a progression system.
farminghabit.details: My first project with an NPC: a habit app with a farming RPG theme. Sign-in and sync mean people can pick up where they left off on another device.
highlights: Built the consistency heatmap and progression system.
Implemented sign-in and sync with Supabase.

prisma.category: I led three developers on a psychometric tool for implicit association tests (IAT) and talked to the people using it before every release.
prisma.details: PRISMA IAT is psychometric software for running implicit association tests (IAT) in research and education.
highlights: Led a team of three developers: set priorities, assigned tasks and tracked deliverables.
Wrote full-stack code in React and TypeScript, with the back end split into Model, Repository and Service layers.
Was the point of contact between the developers, faculty and the requesting user.

nexus.title: Innovation Fellow | Front-end Tech Lead
nexus.description: On Nexus AI, I'm the front-end tech lead and review the team's code.

pet.title: Fellow | PET Digital Health
pet.description: I'm part of the team building the Electronic Call Panel, which supports patient flow in public healthcare.

cosmos.title: Front-end Developer
cosmos.description: I worked with React and TypeScript, integrated REST APIs and contributed to the product's full-stack development.

prisma.title: Development Team Lead | PRISMA
prisma.description: I led three developers and built a psychometric platform for IAT research with them.

research.title: Scientific Research Fellow | PIBIC Jr.
research.description: I used Python in research on intrusion detection in IoT networks.
